observations: Single photo showing a white plastic IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tank inside a galvanized steel cage frame.
Black screw-cap lid visible on top of the tank.
A hand is touching the cage, giving some scale.
Background shows a stack of other IBC tanks, some with visibly rust-stained or discolored cages, suggesting a yard of used/reconditioned units.
Only one angle is shown; the bottom of the tank, the outlet valve/tap, the pallet base, and the rear/side panels are not visible.

identity.kind: IBC tank (1000L water storage tank with steel cage)

claims.evidence: Generic marketing language; no stress test or damage-free confirmation possible from a photo.
No food-grade marking, HDPE code, or manufacturer label visible on the tank in photo 0.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No usage history, prior content, or documentation shown; cannot confirm from an image.
Only the front/top of the tank is shown; sides, back, and bottom (common crack/leak points) are not visible, and no water-fill test is shown.
Top lid is visible and appears present in photo 0, but the bottom outlet valve/cap is not shown, so 'lids complete' cannot be fully confirmed.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged bottom outlet valve (ball valve/tap), a common failure point on used IBC tanks.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bottom valve assembly from underneath or the side.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if valve is missing or non-functional

risks.risk: Cracks or stress marks on the sides/base not visible in the single supplied photo.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the base, plus a shot of the tank filled with water to check for leaks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if leak-prone / not leak-tested

risks.risk: Cage corrosion/rust, as seen on other units in the background stack; could weaken structural support.
risks.proof: Close-up of this specific tank's cage, especially joints and base frame.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if cage has rust/weak points

risks.risk: Actual prior contents unknown; 'food grade, used once for water' is an unverified seller claim and tanks are sometimes reused from chemical transport.
risks.proof: Original manufacturer plate/sticker showing food-grade UN rating and prior contents, or a receipt/invoice trail.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if prior contents unknown (non-food-grade risk)

risks.risk: Pallet/base condition (wood or plastic) not shown; a cracked base pallet affects usability and transport.
risks.proof: Photo of the base/pallet from underneath or at an angle showing the full footing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if base condition is poor

proof_requests: Photo of the bottom outlet valve/tap in close-up
Photos of all four sides and the base of the tank
Photo of the manufacturer's data plate (for food-grade/UN rating and original contents)
A video of the tank being filled or holding water to confirm no leaks
Close-up of the cage frame condition on this specific unit (not the background stock)
response.reason: The item is clearly an identifiable IBC tank by type, but seller claims of food-grade history, structural soundness, and leak-free condition are unverifiable from a single photo, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified leak/valve/food-grade status) pending the listed proofs.
